report.summary: Production KGs (Google KG, Wikidata, DBpedia) use temporal provenance: facts tagged with source version & timestamp. Entity resolution uses blocking + ML (Diffbot ~95% accuracy). Staleness: source change monitoring triggers diff-based re-extraction. Invalidation: on source update, deprecate old-version facts. Key: Knowledge Vault (Dong 2014) uses probabilistic fusion; DBpedia Live updates from Wikipedia; Wikidata uses time qualifiers. Action: versioned fact tables with source UUIDs; on change, flag affected facts for re-evaluation.
risks: Citations from memory, no exact numbers verified.

handoff.suggestion: Implement a versioned provenance model where each fact is linked to its source snapshot ID. Use a diff engine to detect changed entities in sources and invalidate only facts derived from outdated snapshots, triggering selective re-extraction.
